hero.heading:
We build it, we run it,
and we make it smarter.
hero.intro: Innova Group is a licensed multi-disciplinary company based in Meydan, Dubai. Eight service lines — from turnkey contracting and facility management through to marketing and applied artificial intelligence — held together by one team and one point of accountability.

intro.heading:
Most projects don't fail on site.
They fail in the gaps.
intro.lead: Between the designer and the contractor. Between handover and the first year of operation. Between a good product and the market understanding it.
body: Innova Group was built to close those gaps. We hold contracting, project management, facility maintenance, snagging, specialist cinema installation, marketing, management consultancy and artificial intelligence under one roof — so a client can start a conversation about a fit-out and finish it with a building that runs properly, a brand that lands, and systems that are ready for what comes next.
You can engage any one of these disciplines on its own. Most clients end up using more than one.

servicesSection.heading: Eight disciplines, one standard
servicesSection.sub: Each service line runs on its own team, its own process and its own packages. Choose the one you need.

items.title: One accountable party
items.text: When contracting, management and maintenance sit in the same group, there is nobody left to blame — and nothing left to fall between contracts.

items.title: Programme first
items.text: Dates are commitments, not aspirations. Every engagement starts with a programme, a cost plan and the reporting rhythm that keeps both honest.

items.title: Documented, not remembered
items.text: Photographic reports, snag registers, asset lists and O&M records. You keep the evidence, not just the outcome.

items.title: Built for what's next
items.text: An in-house AI practice means the systems we hand over are designed to be automated, measured and improved — not replaced in three years.

items.title: Rooted in Dubai
items.text: A licensed UAE company that knows local authorities, approvals, developer handover standards and the realities of building here.

items.title: Scoped in packages
items.text: Every service line is offered in clear tiers, so you know what is included and what it costs before anyone starts work.

steps.title: Listen
steps.text: A conversation about the outcome you need, the constraints you're under and the date it has to happen by.

steps.title: Scope
steps.text: A written proposal: what is included, what is excluded, what it costs and how long it takes.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: One project lead, a fixed reporting rhythm, and no surprises that arrive after the fact.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: Handover documentation, a defects period, and a maintenance option if you want us to keep it running.

cta.heading: Tell us what you're planning
cta.text: Whether it's a fit-out, a handover inspection, a rebrand or an AI pilot — start with a conversation. No obligation.

about.metaDescription: Innova Group is a licensed multi-disciplinary company in Meydan, Dubai, UAE, operating eight service lines under one point of accountability.
about.heading: One group, assembled on purpose.
about.intro: Innova Group brings construction, operations, communication and technology disciplines into a single licensed company in Meydan, Dubai — so clients stop managing the seams between suppliers.

sections.heading: Built around the handover, not the contract
body: Most companies in this market are organised around a single transaction: a build, a campaign, a report. The client is left to carry everything that happens between those transactions — the coordination, the follow-up, the arguments about whose scope a problem belongs to.

Innova Group is organised the other way around. Our service lines were chosen because they sit next to each other in a real client's life: you build a space, you check it before you accept it, you keep it running, you tell the market about it, and you make the whole operation smarter over time.

sections.heading: Small teams, written scope, one lead
body: Every engagement has a named lead who owns the outcome. Every proposal states what is included and what is not. Every project ends with documentation you keep — drawings, registers, asset lists, reports — so the knowledge stays with you rather than with us.
We are deliberate about the work we take on. If a brief needs a specialism we don't have, we say so and help you find it.

items.title: Say the number
items.text: Costs, dates and exclusions are written down before work starts, not discovered during it.

items.title: Show the evidence
items.text: Photographs, readings, registers and reports. Claims about quality should be verifiable.

items.title: Own the coordination
items.text: Managing the suppliers is our job, not the client's. That is the point of a group.

items.title: Leave it maintainable
items.text: Anything we build should be operable and improvable by someone other than us.
